name: Hound's-tongue
desc: Hound's-tongue (Cynoglossum officinale): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 10 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Cynoglossum officinale (houndstongue, houndstooth, dog's tongue, gypsy flower, and rats and mice due to its smell) is a herbaceous plant of the family Boraginaceae.
